raw_requests: Private; hashes retained. No raw prompt/image payloads exported.
redaction_note: Original input hashes identify pre-redaction bytes. Export hashes identify public bytes; redacted generated text may not regrade identically.
privacy_scope: Known local paths/user/host, email-like strings, secret patterns and data URIs removed; pattern scan is not proof against all personal information. Root review required.
certification: Evidence export does not itself certify broader quality or change defaults.
